tasks.title: Complete User Authentication System
tasks.description: Implement comprehensive user authentication and authorization system using Supabase
tasks.details: Set up user registration, login, logout, and session management. Implement secure authentication flow with proper error handling and user feedback.
tasks.testStrategy: Test user registration, login, logout flows. Verify session persistence and security measures.

tasks.title: Implement File Upload System
tasks.description: Create robust file upload functionality for images and videos with validation and progress tracking
tasks.details: Build file upload component with drag-and-drop support, file type validation, size limits, and upload progress indicators.
tasks.testStrategy: Test various file types, sizes, and upload scenarios. Verify progress tracking and error handling.

tasks.title: Integrate AI Model Inference API
tasks.description: Connect frontend to the FastAPI inference service for AI model predictions
tasks.details: Implement API client to communicate with the inference service. Handle model selection, file upload to API, and result processing.
tasks.testStrategy: Test API communication, model selection, and result handling. Verify error scenarios and timeout handling.

tasks.title: Create Dashboard Analytics
tasks.description: Build comprehensive dashboard with user statistics and analytics
tasks.details: Implement dashboard with upload statistics, processing times, success rates, and recent activity feed. Include charts and visualizations.
tasks.testStrategy: Test dashboard data accuracy, real-time updates, and responsive design across devices.

tasks.title: Implement Results Visualization
tasks.description: Create interactive result display with annotated images and segmentation overlays
tasks.details: Build result viewer component to display AI analysis results with bounding boxes, segmentation masks, and detection labels.
tasks.testStrategy: Test result display accuracy, image annotation rendering, and download functionality.

tasks.title: Add Upload History Management
tasks.description: Implement upload history tracking and management system
tasks.details: Create history page to display past uploads with filtering, sorting, and search capabilities. Include result access and re-analysis options.
tasks.testStrategy: Test history display, filtering, and search functionality. Verify data persistence and retrieval.

tasks.title: Implement Settings and User Profile
tasks.description: Create user settings page with profile management and preferences
tasks.details: Build settings page for user profile editing, preferences configuration, and account management options.
tasks.testStrategy: Test profile updates, settings persistence, and user preference handling.

tasks.title: Add Help and Support System
tasks.description: Implement help documentation and support contact system
tasks.details: Create help page with documentation, FAQs, and support contact form. Include user guidance and troubleshooting information.
tasks.testStrategy: Test help content accessibility, support form functionality, and user guidance effectiveness.

tasks.title: Optimize Performance and Loading States
tasks.description: Implement performance optimizations and improve user experience with loading states
tasks.details: Add loading indicators, skeleton screens, and optimize component rendering. Implement lazy loading and caching strategies.
tasks.testStrategy: Test loading states, performance metrics, and user experience across different network conditions.

tasks.title: Implement Error Handling and Validation
tasks.description: Add comprehensive error handling and input validation throughout the application
tasks.details: Implement proper error boundaries, form validation, API error handling, and user-friendly error messages.
tasks.testStrategy: Test error scenarios, validation rules, and error message clarity. Verify error recovery mechanisms.

tasks.title: Add Theme Support and Responsive Design
tasks.description: Implement dark/light theme support and ensure responsive design across all devices
tasks.details: Add theme switching functionality, ensure mobile responsiveness, and optimize UI for different screen sizes.
tasks.testStrategy: Test theme switching, responsive design across devices, and accessibility compliance.

tasks.title: Implement Model Comparison Features
tasks.description: Add functionality to compare results from different AI models
tasks.details: Create comparison tools to analyze results from YOLO, SAM, and Mask R-CNN models side by side.
tasks.testStrategy: Test model comparison accuracy, UI usability, and result interpretation clarity.

tasks.title: Add Export and Sharing Capabilities
tasks.description: Implement result export and sharing functionality
tasks.details: Add options to export results as images, PDFs, or share via links. Include result annotation and metadata.
tasks.testStrategy: Test export functionality, file format accuracy, and sharing link validity.

tasks.title: Implement Batch Processing
tasks.description: Add support for batch upload and processing of multiple files
tasks.details: Create batch upload interface, progress tracking for multiple files, and batch result management.
tasks.testStrategy: Test batch upload functionality, progress tracking accuracy, and batch result organization.

tasks.title: Add Advanced Analytics Dashboard
tasks.description: Create detailed analytics with model performance metrics and user insights
tasks.details: Implement advanced analytics with model accuracy metrics, processing time analysis, and user behavior insights.
tasks.testStrategy: Test analytics accuracy, data visualization effectiveness, and insight generation quality.
